requiredClientIdentifiers.label: SIRET
requiredClientIdentifiers.why: Chorus Pro identifies every public-sector recipient by its SIRET (the 14-digit establishment number) — the SAME "LEGAL_ID" scheme this catalog already uses for a French client's own identifier (see country-identifiers/data/fr.json, which already accepts both the 9-digit SIREN and the 14-digit SIRET). A government client with no SIRET on file cannot be routed to Chorus Pro at all.

requiredDocumentFields.label: Code service (destinataire)
requiredDocumentFields.why: Chorus Pro routes an invoice inside a public entity by a "code service" identifying which department/service ordered it — not every public entity requires one (it depends on how that entity organized its own Chorus Pro account), so this stays optional rather than a hard block. Reuses the SAME generic `buyerReference` field the DE/XRechnung rule below also reads (`formats/shared-build.ts#extractBuyerReference`, `country-fields/data/de.json`'s own header) — a deliberate modeling choice, not a coincidence: both are "which unit inside the recipient should receive this" facts, even though French doctrine calls it "code service" and German law calls it "Leitweg-ID".

provenance.sourceText: Code de la commande publique, art. L. 2192-1 (LOI n°2022-1157 du 16 août 2022, art. 26) : « Les titulaires de marchés conclus avec les personnes morales de droit public, ainsi que leurs sous-traitants admis au paiement direct, transmettent leurs factures sous forme électronique. » Art. L. 2192-2 (même loi) : « Les personnes morales de droit public acceptent les factures transmises sous forme électronique par les titulaires de marchés mentionnés à l'article L. 2192-1 et leurs sous-traitants admis au paiement direct. » Art. L. 2192-5 (LOI n°2026-103 du 19 février 2026, art. 123) : « Une solution mutualisée, mise à disposition par l'Etat et dénommée " portail public de facturation ", permet le dépôt, la réception et la transmission des factures sous forme électronique [...]. Pour la mise en œuvre des obligations fixées à la sous-section 1 de la présente section, utilisent le portail public de facturation : 1° L'Etat, les collectivités territoriales et les établissements publics ; 2° Les titulaires de marchés conclus avec un acheteur mentionné au 1° ainsi que leurs sous-traitants admis au paiement direct. »

rule.notes: READ DIRECTLY on 2026-09-01 at codes.droit.org (official PDF of the Code de la commande publique, https://codes.droit.org/PDF/Code%20de%20la%20commande%20publique.pdf, articles L. 2192-1/L. 2192-2/L. 2192-5 — see sourceText above, a verbatim citation extracted from the PDF itself, not paraphrased). Légifrance kept refusing every automated request (the same wall country-policy/data/fr.json and country-identifiers/data/fr.json already document for this specific site). EUROPEAN BASELINE common to the three countries in this wave: directive 2014/55/EU, art. 7 (EUR-Lex, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32014L0055, checked 2026-09-01): « Member States shall ensure that contracting authorities and contracting entities receive and process electronic invoices which comply with the European standard on electronic invoicing [...] » — this directive imposes RECEIPT by the contracting authority, never issuance by the supplier; it is art. L. 2192-1 et seq. above that, under French law, impose electronic issuance by the contract holder IN RETURN. `transportId: "chorus-pro"` DELIBERATELY references a channel that does NOT EXIST in `transports/transport-registry.ts` (email/pdp/ksef/sdi only) — that is this model's own thesis (see actions/invoice-actions.ts's own header): the legal text above names "le portail public de facturation" (operated under the "Chorus Pro" brand by the AIFE — a well-known fact, documented elsewhere in this repository at `documentation/compliance/FR-France.md`, but NOT re-confirmed at its primary source by THIS task, for lack of access: chorus-pro.gouv.fr/portail.chorus-pro.gouv.fr are JavaScript applications that render no text to a plain request), never one of the four channels already implemented here — sending must therefore REFUSE, by naming it, rather than silently routing to a channel (email, pdp) the text does not designate. `formatSyntax: "facturx"` is a DELIBERATE choice but NOT re-verified against Chorus Pro's own documentation (the Chorus Pro community site, communaute.chorus-pro.gouv.fr, rendered no usable text to this task either): Factur-X is the hybrid PDF/XML EN 16931 format this repository already builds (`formats/facturx-provider.ts`) and the format already used for the existing French PDP channel (`transports/pdp-transport.ts`) — a choice consistent with what already exists rather than an independently sourced fact about exactly what Chorus Pro accepts (UBL is also probably accepted; not settled here).
